facts.P1_fx_receipts: Partly confirmed; individuals' foreign receipts are historically "free funds" in Nostro accounts.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: foreign-currency (Nostro FCA) accounts are standard.

facts.L1_registration: No company registration; register for tax with ZIMRA on the TaRMS portal.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from ZIMRA's TaRMS portal, replacing the old BP number.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Work done in Zimbabwe is likely taxable there, up to 40%.

facts.L5_data_protection: Processing data of 50+ people needs a yearly POTRAZ licence from US$50.
